title: High-Value Transaction Threshold Verification
content: Transactions exceeding $250.00 with customer historical transaction count under 2 in 24 hours must trigger automated secondary risk assessment. Analysts must check if the transaction occurs outside normal customer operating hours (23:00 - 05:00) and verify terminal velocity.
action: Flag for manual verification or stepped-up authentication (3D Secure / OTP).

title: Terminal Fraud-Spike Containment Protocol
content: When a merchant terminal exhibits a 7-day fraud rate spike ratio >= 3.0x over its 30-day baseline with a minimum volume of 10 transactions, the terminal is classified as ALERT_HIGH. Defensive protocol mandates temporary hold on settlement payouts and proactive merchant outbound audit.
rules: Terminal 7-Day Fraud Rate / Baseline Fraud Rate >= 3.0
action: Restrict payouts, notify Merchant Risk Operations, request invoice & fulfillment proof.

title: Chargeback Defense & Dispute Evidence Checklist
content: For disputed transactions flagged under fraud code 10.4 (Card-Not-Present Fraud), merchants must submit compelling evidence within 7 calendar days: IP address log matching cardholder billing country, AVS (Address Verification System) response code 'Y', signed delivery receipt, and customer communication records.
action: Compile compelling evidence package via Razorpay Merchant Dashboard and submit to acquiring bank.

title: Cost-Sensitive Fraud Risk Scoring Standard
content: SentinelPay operates on cost-sensitive risk evaluation where False Negative cost (FN_COST=$10) heavily outweighs False Positive cost (FP_COST=$1). ML decision thresholds are locked strictly on validation set cost curves. RAG engines are strictly prohibited from altering ML probability scores.
rules: Threshold set by validation cost curve minimization
action: Expose ML score, model feature importances, and locked decision threshold without post-hoc score modification.

title: Delayed Fraud Reporting & Velocity Anomaly Handling
content: Merchant historical risk metrics incorporate a mandatory 7-day label reporting delay to reflect real-world chargeback notice latency. Rapid velocity spikes (e.g., > 5 transactions in 1 hour per customer) trigger high risk prior to label confirmation.
